fusions.name: Shot From the Skirting
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow from cover that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, up to 10 tiles away. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Gnawed String
fusions.desc: A gnawed bowstring snaps, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Another Loophole
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds and shifts you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet.
